evals.prompt: Write a Strudel.cc live-coding snippet for a driving techno groove at 130 BPM. Include a four-on-the-floor kick, an offbeat clap, and closed hi-hats layered together.
assertions: Sets the tempo with setcpm() where the numeric argument is the BPM divided by 4 (e.g. setcpm(130/4) or the equivalent 32.5), not setcpm(130) nor a setbpm/cps call
Combines the kick, clap, and hi-hat parts inside a single stack(...) call so they play in parallel
Uses mini-notation with the kick as s("bd*4") (or bd repeated four times) for four-on-the-floor

evals.prompt: In Strudel, create a percussion pattern where the kick note cycles through four different pitches, one new pitch on each successive cycle, and a snare plays a Euclidean rhythm of 3 hits spread across 8 steps.
assertions: Expresses the per-cycle pitch rotation with angle-bracket alternation mini-notation, e.g. "<a b c d>", where one value is selected per cycle
Expresses the snare rhythm with Euclidean mini-notation of the form name(3,8)

evals.prompt: Write a Strudel acid bassline on a sawtooth oscillator whose low-pass filter cutoff continuously sweeps open and closed over a 4-cycle period, with heavy filter resonance.
assertions: Modulates the low-pass cutoff by passing a signal into .lpf(), specifically a sine.range(min, max) chained with .slow(4) (rather than a static numeric cutoff)
Adds filter resonance via a .lpq(...) call

evals.prompt: In Strudel, write a short melodic line constrained to an A minor scale in a low octave, plus a pad layer that plays explicit chords (an A minor and an F major triad). Keep the two layers harmonically coherent.
assertions: Constrains the melody notes with a .scale(...) call using colon-separated scale notation such as "A3:minor" (tonic:mode)
Writes the pad chords using apostrophe chord notation on note values, e.g. note("a3'min") and note with 'maj (a<octave>'min / f<octave>'maj)
